description: Asking whether Wi-Fi is on should select the system domain's wifi_status read (no mutation, no Settings window).
prompt: Is my Wi-Fi on right now?
How much battery do I have left?

description: Opening a Settings pane maps to open_settings (a deep link, not a mutation gated by execute).
prompt: Open the Display settings for me.

description: Listing remembered Wi-Fi networks maps to list_preferred_wifi.
prompt: What Wi-Fi networks does this Mac remember?

description: 'What Mac do I have?' maps to the about_this_mac hardware/version overview, not a Settings window or a process read.
prompt: What Mac do I have — which chip and how much memory?

description: Free-disk-space questions map to the system disk_usage read (per-volume df), not filesystem du (which sizes a directory).
prompt: How much free disk space do I have left?

description: 'How long since reboot' maps to the uptime read.
prompt: How long has my Mac been running since the last reboot?

description: Pairing a Bluetooth device has no CLI: the right move is open_settings (pane bluetooth) plus click-path guidance mentioning pairing mode. Opens a real Settings window when run.
prompt: I want to pair my wireless mouse with my Mac.

description: Apple Account / iCloud asks route to open_settings (pane apple_id) with sign-in guidance. Opens a real Settings window when run.
prompt: Help me sign into iCloud on this Mac.

description: Focus/Do Not Disturb has no first-party CLI: route to open_settings (pane focus) with toggle guidance, not a refusal. Opens a real Settings window when run.
Update questions map to software_update_check. Manual: contacts Apple's servers and can take up to a minute.
prompt: Is my macOS up to date? Any updates pending?
